headline: Kim Seung-yeon who acquired Samsung Techwin, Kim Dong-kwan who built KAI's 15.89%: 12 years of the Hanwha father and son's 'sky'
summary: After Kim Dong-kwan was promoted to Hanwha Group vice chairman on August 1, Hanwha's stake in Korea Aerospace Industries rose to 15.89%. The report also covers the Hanwha family's past acquisitions, including Samsung Techwin.
why: Korea Aerospace Industries is a major South Korean aerospace and defense manufacturer, and Hanwha is a diversified conglomerate with defense interests.
